title: [4.7.dev4] Crash related to container maximum size and label autowrap
body:
### Tested versions

-Reproducible in 4.7.dev4
-Not reproducible in earlier versions due to control maximum size not yet being introduced

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev4.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9174) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads) - 63.74 GiB memory

### Issue description

Related : #116640

It is possible for a label with several levels of BoxContainer parents to cause a crash when its parent's maximum size would clip the label and the label's autowrap mode is set to anything other than Off.

### Steps to reproduce

This is the least complex way I could find to trigger the crash:

- Create a scene containing a VBoxContainer with maximum size set to (1, 1)
- Add a control node child to the VBoxContainer
- Add an HBoxContainer child to the VBoxContainer
- Add two control node children to the HBoxContainer
- Add a label child to the HBoxContainer with some text (i.e. "Text")
- Set the label's autowrap mode to Arbitrary
- Crash

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[label_wrap_crash_mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26662546/label_wrap_crash_mrp.zip)

Simply set the label's autowrap mode to Arbitrary to trigger the crash.
